material_definitions: Lithium ion conductors based on Li2M3+M4+P3O12 (M3+=Cr, Fe, In; M4+=Ti, Zr and Hf) have been synthesized.
The Li2InTiP3O12 material belongs to this series of compounds.

material_definitions: These materials are NASICON-type solid electrolytes with the general formula Li2M(III)M(IV)P3O12, where M(III) is Cr, Fe, or In, and M(IV) is Ti, Zr, or Hf. They are synthesized to investigate the effect of substituting M(III) and M(IV) cations on ionic conductivity and activation energy. Li2InTiP3O12 and Li2InZrP3O12 show two distinct activation energy regions.
measurements.source_caption: Table 2: The maximum dispersion in the *E,* values obtained from measurements on different pellets of a given composition is 1 to 1.5 kJ/mol. Fig. 1 illustrates the linear plots of *log(aT) vs. 1000/T* for the Cr and In analogues. The Li,InTiP,O,, and Li,InZrP,O,, compounds show that the Arrhenius plots have two straight lines with differing slopes. The low temperature region has a slope of 34 kJ/mol and 58 kJ/mol and at the high temperature region 21 and 48 kJ/mol for the Ti and Zr analogues respectively. The *E,* value of Li,InTiP,O,, compares well
